2609.19871.title: Physical knowledge on historical data matters more than enforcing physical constraints on the forecast
2609.19871.paper_summary: Time series forecasting has seen signicant advancements with the emergence of new deep learning models. However, forecasting time series in applications involving physical processes remains a major challenge. Despite the apparition of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINN), recent models do not estimate unobservable intermediate physical variables, which are important for domain experts to understand the target behavior. To this end, we propose a Physics Informed Recurrent Neural Network (PIRNN) which predicts, along the target, unobservable variables on both historic data and forecast target. This approach enhances the model robustness and results interpretation using domain knowledge. Our method is easily adaptable to any physical model using several equations, each having its own set of unobservable variables, to describe it-self. As a case study, we incorporate physical equations used for groundwater levels predictions by the physical model called Gardenia. This model uses transfers equations between reservoirs, optimized with data assimilation, to simulate the evolution of groundwater levels. Evaluation includes several well known neural network models and the Gardenia model compared on twelve real world datasets. In addition, we study the impact of each component through an ablation study. Our model outperforms other models on ve out of the twelve datasets and our ablation study underlines the importance of having a physical background in our time series forecasting task. Finally, the coherence of the physical variables predicted by our neural network is assessed by a domain expert.
2609.19871.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列預測隨著新深度學習模型的出現而取得了顯著的進展。<lb/>然而，在涉及物理過程的應用中預測時間序列仍然是一個主要挑戰。<lb/>儘管物理知識驅動的神經網絡（PINN）出現了，最近的模型並未估計不可觀察的中間物理變量，而這些變量對於領域專家理解目標行為非常重要。<lb/>為此，我們提出了一種物理知識驅動的遞歸神經網絡（PIRNN），該網絡在預測目標的同時，還預測歷史數據和預測目標上的不可觀察變量。<lb/>這種方法利用領域知識增強了模型的穩健性和結果解釋。<lb/>我們的方法可以輕鬆適應任何物理模型，使用幾個方程式，每個方程式都有自己的一組不可觀察變量來描述它自身。<lb/>作為案例研究，我們納入了物理模型Gardenia中用於地下水位預測的物理方程。<lb/>該模型使用水庫之間的轉移方程，並通過數據同化進行優化，以模擬地下水位的演變。<lb/>評估包括幾個著名的神經網絡模型和Gardenia模型在十二個真實世界數據集上的比較。<lb/>此外，我們通過消融研究研究每個組件的影響。<lb/>我們的模型在十二個數據集中的五個上表現優於其他模型，並且我們的消融研究強調了在我們的時間序列預測任務中擁有物理背景的重要性。<lb/>最後，我們的神經網絡預測的物理變量的一致性由領域專家進行評估。
